sc: Child from Gedaref, fever 1 month, huge spleen, pancytopenia → Kala-azar: rK39 test
Papules around the mouth months after kala-azar treatment → PKDL
Kala-azar with HIV or severe disease → Liposomal amphotericin B
f: Prolonged fever (> 2 weeks) · wasting · abdominal swelling · bleeding (nose, gums)
Massive splenomegaly · hepatomegaly · pallor · wasting · lymph nodes · darkened skin
rK39 RDT (first) · DAT · splenic aspirate (LD bodies, most sensitive ~95%) · pancytopenia, high globulins
SSG 20 mg/kg/day + paromomycin for 17 days · or paromomycin + miltefosine 14 days · severe/HIV: liposomal amphotericin B
Fever settles, spleen shrinks, Hb and weight rise · relapse: tissue aspirate (serology stays positive) · SSG: ECG
Bleeding · secondary infection (pneumonia, TB) · PKDL · death if untreated
trap: Serology stays positive after cure: use aspirate for relapse · fever + huge spleen + pancytopenia also = leukaemia: look at the film · SSG needs ECG monitoring
